items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: and Leonard Feather was there and many other great dignitaries was there.

ctx.x: Now, how can -- and Leonard Feather was there and many other great dignitaries was there. How is it, when I look through the discography of musicians in the '70s or farther back than that, that I don't find the name Whaley? It disturbs me greatly.
I wonder why, just like Long John Nebel, see. Sy Oliver introduced me to him, see, and he says, I ought to have you on the show sometime, but never did.
